children: ACS offers a compelling entry point in light of the share decline over past months due to deteriorating sentiment around data centers, J.P. Morgan says in a note. "We believe the market is underestimating both the visibility and the longevity of ACS's data center growth, with its secured backlog already underpinning consensus expectations and a substantial pipeline of additional opportunities pointing to upside through 2030," J.P. Morgan writes. The Spanish construction company's November capital markets day will give management a chance to dispel fears of a slowdown and reset expectations on medium-term growth. J.P. Morgan initiates ACS stock at overweight with a target price of 127 euros. Shares trade 0.6% lower at 89.50 euros. (sarah.sloat@wsj.com)
